subject: BlueHarbor reseller credentials to clear invoice hold
messages:
From: BlueHarbor Logistics <accounts-payable@blueharbor.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: finance@blueharbor.com
Date: Fri, 07 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: tax-exempt credentials to release invoice INV-2397

Hi Karthik,

We're holding payment on invoice INV-2397 while we validate reseller/tax-exempt credentials on file for Redwood. Our AP team needs a completed resale/exemption certificate that satisfies Ohio and Minnesota jurisdictions (customer shipping addresses span both states). Can you confirm what exact fields Redwood requires on the certificate so we can provide a valid signed copy?

Specifics we have so far: BlueHarbor Logistics, remit address 210 Harbor Lane, Cleveland, OH. Invoice total $42,350. Please let us know whether a stamped state registration number or seller EIN is required.

We'd like to clear the hold by end of next week; any help appreciated.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Accounts Payable
BlueHarbor Logistics
attachments: none
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: BlueHarbor Logistics <accounts-payable@blueharbor.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 07 Nov 2025 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: tax-exempt credentials to release invoice INV-2397

Ellen — thanks for the note and for the clear invoice reference. Short answer: we can accept a standard state resale certificate for the buyer with the following required elements so our billing team can remove the hold:

- Buyer name and full business address (must match billing/shipping on the invoice)
- Statement of purchase for resale (or equivalent language per state form)
- Buyer's state tax registration / resale certificate number (if the state requires it)
- Signature and printed name of authorized buyer representative + date
- Effective date (cannot be post-dated)
- Seller information: Redwood Inference, 480 Bryant St., San Francisco, CA 94107, HAAR-987654321 (Redwood's vendor ID for your records)

For Ohio specifically we need the buyer's Ohio Vendor's License number (if they are registered) or the certificate must use the Ohio ST3 form equivalent. For Minnesota, please ensure the certificate indicates exemption for resale (most MN forms are fine).

I'll attach our blank template (Redwood_Resale_Template_2025.pdf) to make this faster. If you can sign and return a scanned PDF to this thread, I'll triage it immediately with Billing and request release of INV-2397.

If it's easier for you, we can send a DocuSign envelope — we've used that for a few partners. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/Redwood/Signin/verify-resale

Thanks — I'll keep Monica (billing) looped so we can clear the invoice once verified.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_Resale_Template_2025.pdf (application/pdf)
From: BlueHarbor Logistics <ellen.park@blueharbor.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: finance@blueharbor.com
Date: Tue, 11 Nov 2025 08:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: tax-exempt credentials to release invoice INV-2397

Karthik — thanks for the template. Attached is the signed certificate from our tax team (BlueHarbor_RES_CERT_2025.pdf). Quick note: the certificate we returned uses our national reseller number but the Ohio field (Vendor's License) was left blank on the form we received from our state team.

If you require the Ohio Vendor's License specifically, our tax lead says they can provide it by tomorrow. Please advise whether the national reseller number + signature will suffice in the meantime so we can avoid extended hold.

Attached: BlueHarbor_RES_CERT_2025.pdf (image/pdf scan)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: BlueHarbor Logistics <ellen.park@blueharbor.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 Nov 2025 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: tax-exempt credentials to release invoice INV-2397

Ellen — got the scanned certificate, thanks. I reviewed it and it's mostly complete: signature, buyer name and address, and the national reseller number are present. For Ohio we do need the state's Vendor's License number on the certificate or an addendum reference (that's the requirement our tax team enforces for OH-originating shipments).

Option A: If your tax lead can supply the Ohio Vendor's License number by tomorrow, we can accept the certificate and clear the hold immediately.
Option B: If timing is tight, we can provisionally release the invoice pending submission of the Ohio number within 7 business days, but we'd need a short written acknowledgement from BlueHarbor accepting that the release is contingent on receipt of the number. If you choose Option B, please reply confirming and we'll instruct Billing to process.

Monica — can you hold a provisional release for INV-2397 if BlueHarbor confirms Option B? If not, please advise timeline to process with Option A.

—Karthik
attachments: none (certificate attached by customer)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: BlueHarbor Logistics <accounts-payable@blueharbor.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: INV-2397 release confirmation

Hi Ellen / BlueHarbor team —

Thanks for sending the certificate and for the quick follow-up. Per Karthik's note we are able to provisionally release invoice INV-2397 for payment today on the condition that BlueHarbor provides the Ohio Vendor's License number within 7 business days. Please confirm in reply to this thread that you accept that contingency.

Action taken: released hold on INV-2397, payment window opened; reference: PAYMENT-REL-20251112-INV2397. If the Ohio number is not received within the 7-business-day window we will follow the standard policy and re-open the hold and notify AP.

Attached: invoice_INV-2397_release_note.pdf
